thesis: The morning thesis is intact. PGNY gave back 1.7% on light volume (vol_ratio 0.77, partial day) to 35.54, and the low of 34.95 held well above the 33.34 post-earnings low and the 32.03 gap low. The trend is still up (above SMA20 32.76, SMA50 29.25 and SMA200 25.08, rs_63 +0.48), and health care is one of the groups leading the risk-off tape. The pullback the morning card asked for has happened: the morning zone of 35.30-36.20 was touched today. Reward/risk at the 35.54 last price is 1.91 against the unchanged 33.2 stop and 40.0 target, up from 1.67 this morning, and 2.16 at the 35.35 midpoint of the 34.90-35.80 zone. The rating stays at Overweight; it is not raised to Buy because of the risk-off regime and the insider selling. Debate skipped (pre-close re-assessment, rating unchanged).
invalidation: A daily close below 33.3 (the 11-06 post-earnings low) negates the setup, and a close below 32.03 back inside the 11-05 gap means the earnings breakout has failed.
key_risks: Risk-off regime (confidence 0.85, QQQ ret_21 -8.1%, VIX percentile 0.858) raises the odds of a gap-fill in momentum names
